scope: Synthetic independent contributor in existing Yggdrasil PR1327; Amalgam PR1278 sole canonical learner owner. No merge, accepted state, first-use #426, owner runner, new controller, scheduler or deployment.
question: Does buffering surprising witnessed outcomes before assigning to active memory protect earlier slot A and improve same-address A-B-A return predictions against original immediate writes and strongest controls?

predecessor.know22_original_retention: 2/2 old A slot readouts drifted after B

source.witness: unchanged TGAP21 witness(seed,role,step,action,first,second): Bernoulli .8 if chosen action matches private binary regime else .2; private source seed/role/switches/coin inaccessible to predictor
source.public: one unchanged address, public step and action t%2; no entity knowledge leakage
source.transfer: fresh synthetic seeds and switch schedules, same two-action grammar not novel causal-law operator

fit.snapshots: After t=21 record slot0 A forecasts; after t=46 record slot0 B-phase forecasts and count drift. No private stage boundary supplied to learner.

budget.buffer_replay: Internal reuse of already witnessed event counts as extra compute but not new environment observation; report total replay operations.

algorithm.name: QuarantineWriteMemory, experimental numeric two-slot beta(1,1) not native Yggdrasil
algorithm.state: Two slots x two binary actions each (success,count), active index, six private-free (action,outcome) pending events, six anomaly bits, since-switch, event counters, canonical hash-pinned checkpoint.
algorithm.mature: Both actions in current slot have at least four assigned observations; until then immediately assign witnessed events to active slot
algorithm.anomaly: At pre-action p>=0.65, reward0; or p<=0.35, reward1. Keep sliding last six anomaly bits.
algorithm.quarantine: When slot mature, buffer event instead of immediately writing to slot. If >=3 anomalies in six and >=8 events since prior switch, toggle active slot, assign all buffered already-observed events to newly active slot and clear buffer/anomaly ring. Else when pending length reaches six assign only oldest pending event to original active slot.
algorithm.flush: At end of each public episode assign remaining pending events to active slot, without new witness. On new public episode reset action cursor/anomaly ring but retain all previously trained slots.
algorithm.readout: Use identical PRE-witness two-slot posterior mixture with hazard 1/16 in candidate and original immediate-write TwoSlotMemory, posterior starts at 0.5 for each held episode and updates from the same witnessed reward and preupdate slot likelihoods.
algorithm.control_capacity: Report candidate bytes/pending buffers versus original; equality of memory capacity not assumed.
algorithm.source_type: Never provide learner private regime phase, role, switches or unseen future exogenous noise.

controls: Identical original TGAP21 TwoSlotMemory with matched hazard1/16 posterior readout and full FIT
Fully FIT model-informed Bayesian HMM with known .8/.2 and 1/16 hazard
metrics: Prequential Brier overall 512 held steps and return-only 192 steps
Candidate and original slot0 A forecast drift after intervening B on same public address
Strongest conventional overall/return performance, per-role/per-schedule metrics
Cold checkpoint integrity, replay/forged-source negatives, max buffer size, total local replayed events
Elapsed isolated CPU proof time, checkpoint bytes, exact source CI and honest synthetic-only claim

frozen_predicates.H1: candidate overall Brier <= original gate overall Brier - 0.01000
frozen_predicates.H2: candidate return Brier <= original gate return Brier - 0.01000
frozen_predicates.H3: candidate old-A slot0 drift after B < original old-A slot0 drift after B
frozen_predicates.H4: candidate overall Brier <= fully FIT rolling-last8 overall Brier
frozen_predicates.verdict: PROTECTION_SUPPORTED_DEV only if all 4 pass, MIXED_PROTECTION if 1..3 pass, PROTECTION_NO_GO if 0; never scientific PASS from synthetic fixtures.

stop_rules: ONE frozen study. Do not edit seed, timing, threshold, metric, cohort or comparator after scoring. Fix implementation bugs only transparently; preserve all negatives. No live/canonical training, owner acceptance, protected first-use, paid API, new workflow dispatch, extra PR/merge or deployment.
science: Real scientific gain needs independently approved original-world new causal laws, fully trained strongest baselines matched info/actions/capacity/compute, cold same-address retention and independent replication. This DEV result cannot assert that.
